q1_issues.issue: `pacificat` carries a `Name` atom, marking it a named individual, while also filling the class slot of `(GroupOf sk_pacificat_1 pacificat)` — an individual in a class position, which the individual-vs-class discipline forbids; the name string is additionally singularized ("PacifiCat") rather than kept in the surface form "PacifiCats".

q2_gaps: a pluralized proper name denoting a class or series of vessels ("the PacifiCats") — the naming rules give a proper noun one symbol plus exactly one `Name`, and the definite-plural rule wants `(GroupOf <group> <kind>)`, but nothing says how one name symbol can serve as the members' kind, nor what the `Name` string should be for the plural
notes: Distributive replication of the coordinated by-phrase into two design events sharing one Patient, the passive by-phrase taking `Agent`, entity-attached `(From philip_hercus vancouver)` for origin, and the surface-faithful `(Of robert_allan_limited australia)` rather than a coined `LocatedIn`/`Possession` all follow the instruction set. `Patient` for the designed vessels is supportable under the brings-into-existence clause of the change test.
